verses.1: They brought the Ark of God and displayed it inside the temple that David had built. They offered sacrifices and offerings before the God.
verses.2: And David was able to lift up the offerings and sacrifices, and he blessed the people in the name of Jehovah.
verses.3: And he divided for every man in Israel, from one man to another, both male and female, according to the number of dough and barley.
verses.4: And he gave before the altar of Jehovah servants who would serve, and those who would praise and glorify Jehovah, the God of Israel.
verses.5: He gathered them together; Zekriya, Yeiel, Shmiramot, Yehiel, Matityah, Eliahu, and Benyahu also joined him. He also gathered Adam’s servants, along with Yeiel, among all the wicked people. He gathered them in the chambers of Mishmayim.
verses.6: And their sons and descendants, the priests, shall always stand before the Ark of the Covenant.
verses.7: On that day, David gave the Ark to Asaf and his brothers to carry as a offering to Jehovah.
verses.8: Praise the LORD! Call upon His name. Let people everywhere know of His greatness.
verses.9: Sing to him songs of praise in all his glory.
verses.10: They praised in His holy name; their hearts rejoiced for those who seek Jehovah.
verses.11: He will seek Him, and He will be found in His search. His face will always be visible.
verses.12: Remember his miracles that he performed, and the judgments he made.
verses.13: The seed of Israel was given to the servants of Jacob by their choice.
verses.14: He is Jehovah our God, who judges us throughout all the earth.
verses.15: Remember forever his covenant; it was a command that shall be obeyed for thousands of years.
verses.16: Who has killed Abraham and taken his place in Isaac’s lineage.
verses.17: And she made a covenant with Jacob, a forever covenant for Israel.
verses.18: And he said to you, “I will give you the land of Canaan as your inheritance.”
verses.19: In your time, there will be many deaths and people will die.
verses.20: And they went from one country to another, and from one king to another.
verses.21: They did not allow anyone to beat them. The kings did not dare to touch them at all.
verses.22: Do not offend my Messiah and my prophets. Do not rebel against them.
verses.23: Let all the nations praise Jehovah. From day to day, let them proclaim His salvation.
verses.24: Let them spread his glory among all nations; let his praise be heard by every people.
verses.25: For Jehovah is great and very glorious; he is exalted above all gods.
verses.26: For all the gods of the nations are idols, and Jehovah created the heavens.
verses.27: Hod and Hadar stand before him, strong and mighty in their place.
verses.28: Let there be glory and honor for Jehovah among the nations.
verses.29: They offered sacrifices to Jehovah, with the honor due to His name. They came before Him and bowed down in reverence before Jehovah.
verses.30: May all the land tremble before him; even Egypt will not be able to resist his power.
verses.31: May the heavens rejoice, and may the earth be filled with joy. May people say in all nations, “The LORD is the king.”
verses.32: The sea will rage, and its waves will wash over the fields. Everything that is in them will be destroyed.
verses.33: Then we will cut down the trees in the forest before Jehovah, because He has come to redeem the land.
verses.34: Praise Jehovah, for he is good and always shows his kindness.
verses.35: And say, “Save us, O God of salvation! Please rescue us and save us from these nations, so that we may worship Your name with joy in Your holy place.”
verses.36: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from this world to the next. And all the people said, “Amen!” and praised Yahweh.
verses.37: And he left there before the army of God’s covenant. He went to gather his brothers and serve them before the army, always according to God’s commands.
verses.38: And he served Adam and his descendants for sixty years. He also served Adam’s son, and he showed kindness to the animals.
verses.39: And Zadok the priest and his brothers, the priests, stood before the temple of Yahweh in the valley.
verses.40: To offer sacrifices to Jehovah, always in the morning and at noon, and also according to all the laws written in Jehovah’s Torah, which He commanded for Israel.
verses.41: And with them were their priests, their leaders, and all the others who were appointed to serve God. For ever shall His kindness be remembered.
verses.42: And with them were their musicians and singers, who played instruments and sang songs of God. And the sons of their musicians also stood at the door.
verses.43: And all the people went back to their homes. David went to his house to bless it.
